description: Department of Local Government - Southern Province - Meeting for the Purpose of Electing the Chairman
reasoning: The gazette content is a notification made under specific election-related legislation (Local Authorities Elections Ordinance) and announces the schedule for a meeting to elect the Chairman of a Local Authority (Weligama Pradeshiya Sabha). Its primary subject is an electoral process for a local government body, which fits the definition of **Elections Gazettes (Type 7)**. While it names an official (the Commissioner), the notice is not about a government personnel appointment or structural change for the central government; it is an administrative announcement concerning an electoral procedure.
